week13: One of the arguments the British colonizers used to justify the colonization of the Indian subcontinent was that the women in the Indian subcontinent were oppressed and they need to be liberated (see Rafia Zakaria for details). In 'Sultana's Dream', RSH echoed the same argument. I didn't like reading this text. 
overall: She is very flexible about the assignments and very lenient in grading. However, during the semester she updated the syllabus quite a few times and added class on the week of Eid where there was no class before. So some people made the plan to spend the week already in something else but later came to know that there will be a class. If I were to grade like her, I'd grade her teaching 10/10 but since it is not the case and I'm not that lenient, I'd grade 9.5/10.
